name: PublicNotices
description: Public notice board data for county announcements

notices.title: RFP: County IT Infrastructure Modernization
notices.description: Seeking proposals for comprehensive IT infrastructure upgrade including network, security systems, and cloud migration. Estimated project value: $2.5M over 3 years.

notices.title: 2026 Budget Amendment Public Hearing
notices.description: Public hearing on proposed budget amendments for human services funding. Citizens may provide testimony in person or submit written comments.

notices.title: County Controller - Vacancy Appointment
notices.description: The position of County Controller is vacant following the election of Tara Zrinski as County Executive. County Council is accepting applications for appointment to fill the remainder of the term.

notices.title: Bridge Repair - Route 248 Overpass
notices.description: Sealed bids for structural repairs to the Route 248 overpass bridge. Pre-bid meeting required. Prevailing wage applies.

notices.title: Ordinance 2026-03: Short-Term Rental Regulations
notices.description: Proposed ordinance establishing registration requirements and safety standards for short-term rental properties. 30-day public comment period.

notices.title: County Council Regular Meeting
notices.description: Regular meeting of County Council. Agenda includes Controller appointment discussion, budget amendments, and zoning appeals.

notices.title: Assistant District Attorney - Criminal Division
notices.description: Full-time position prosecuting felony cases. JD required, 2+ years criminal law experience preferred. Salary range: $65,000-$85,000.

notices.title: Janitorial Services - Government Center
notices.description: 3-year contract for janitorial services at the Government Center complex. Includes daily cleaning, floor maintenance, and window washing.

notices.title: School Board Election - Petition Filing Deadline
notices.description: Candidates for school board positions must file nomination petitions by February 18, 2026. Petition forms available at the Elections Office.

notices.title: Zoning Variance - 123 Main Street
notices.description: Public hearing on variance request for mixed-use development. Applicant seeks exception to height restrictions. Public comment welcome.
